items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: And when I heard from McGinney was dead.

ctx.x: I want to tell them about what happened to those records. Yeah. When the guy died and everything. Or why he died. What happened?

Oh, well, we did the recording, and before we could release the things, he died. I mean, I think that was good. I think that was during the time, Bessie, that storm came up there, and just straw, you know, plenty of different things he had, little property and all that. And after that, the man, wife quit him and everything. And when I heard from McGinney was dead.
Yeah. Now, uh, Clive, what's your name, anyway? I just want to see if he's picking you up.
